description: Deletes an intent from a Cognigy.AI flow. MUTATING & DESTRUCTIVE: This permanently removes the intent and its example sentences. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. After deleting, call train_intents to retrain.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without deleting. Set to false to actually delete. WARNING: Deletion cannot be undone.

flowId.description: The flow ID containing the intent

intentId.description: The ID of the intent to delete

name: delete_intent
